title: Finite Unique Games instance
statement: A finite Unique Games instance over a domain of size $q$ consists of a finite nonempty set of variables and a finite nonempty set of constraint occurrences. Each occurrence has an ordered pair of distinct endpoints and is labeled by a permutation of the domain, and every variable is an endpoint of at least one occurrence.
hypotheses_covered: Each occurrence has a source and target variable
The endpoints of each occurrence are distinct
Each occurrence is labeled by a permutation of the domain
Every variable participates in some constraint
